layout_description: LTM/LTIMindtree time-and-material invoice with a summary page and employee-hour detail rows on an Annexure page.

field_overrides.name: supplier_name
field_overrides.description: Supplier printed as LTM Limited, with LTIMindtree former-name variants.

field_overrides.name: invoice_number
field_overrides.description: Invoice identifier from the summary page.

field_overrides.name: invoice_date
field_overrides.description: Issue date printed in day/month/year order.

field_overrides.name: billing_period_start
field_overrides.description: First calendar day of the printed billing month; drives EXT_STARTDATE.

field_overrides.name: billing_period_end
field_overrides.description: Last calendar day of the printed billing month; drives EXT_ENDDATE.

field_overrides.name: account_number
field_overrides.description: Constant downstream account label. Never use the supplier bank Account No.(USD).

field_overrides.name: payment_terms
field_overrides.description: Payment terms from the summary page.

field_overrides.name: total_due
field_overrides.description: Invoice total reconciled to the Annexure detail rows.

field_overrides.name: service_id
field_overrides.description: Leading seven-digit employee/service identifier before the hyphen.

field_overrides.name: billing_reference
field_overrides.description: Employee name printed after the seven-digit service id and the hyphen in the Description (e.g. 'Brijesh Dekivadiya' from '8065237 - Brijesh Dekivadiya'). Extract the name only, not the leading id, and do not copy service_id.

field_overrides.name: description
field_overrides.description: Full Annexure description, including the employee name.

field_overrides.name: plan_cost
field_overrides.description: Source for EXT_PLANCOST; absent on current LTM invoices and therefore null.

field_overrides.name: equipment_cost
field_overrides.description: Source for EXT_EQUIPMENTCOST; absent on current LTM invoices and therefore null.

notes: Extract only Annexure employee/hour detail rows. Ignore the page-1 'See Annexure below' summary row. Parse service_id from the leading seven digits in Description, and billing_reference from the employee name printed after the '<id> - ' prefix in the same Description (e.g. '8065237 - Brijesh Dekivadiya' -> service_id 8065237, billing_reference 'Brijesh Dekivadiya'). Extract Quantity as hours, Rate (USD) as unit_rate, and Amount (USD) as amount; quantity multiplied by unit_rate must equal amount. Set document account_number to the literal MindTreeTimeMaterial and never use bank Account No.(USD) 000027731. Billing Period is a month/year value: normalize billing_period_start to the first calendar day and billing_period_end to the last calendar day of that month. Extract invoice_date separately from Invoice Date. Both Sales Tax and Integrated GST variants show a printed rate and amount; preserve an explicit 0% rate so EXT_TAX exports numeric zero. Reconcile Annexure amounts to Annexure Total and page-1 Total.
